question: Will SPCX Stock USD Value Increase 15% by 4:17 P.M, EDT, July 21, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the official NASDAQ last sale price of SPCX at or immediately before 4:17 PM EDT (20:17 UTC) on July 21, 2026 reflects an increase of at least 15% but less than 30% compared to SPCX's official NASDAQ opening price at market open (9:30 AM EDT) on July 21, 2026.
- "Yes x2": Wins if the official NASDAQ last sale price of SPCX at or immediately before 4:17 PM EDT (20:17 UTC) on July 21, 2026 reflects an increase of at least 30% (i.e., 2×15%) compared to SPCX's official NASDAQ opening price at market open (9:30 AM EDT) on July 21, 2026.
- "Maybe": Wins if the official NASDAQ last sale price of SPCX at or immediately before 4:17 PM EDT (20:17 UTC) on July 21, 2026 reflects an increase of less than 15% compared to SPCX's official NASDAQ opening price at market open (9:30 AM EDT) on July 21, 2026, or if SPCX did not trade on July 21, 2026.

Clarifications:
- The reference (baseline) price is SPCX's official NASDAQ opening transaction price at 9:30 AM EDT on July 21, 2026; if no opening print is available at exactly 9:30 AM EDT, use the first official NASDAQ trade price recorded on July 21, 2026.
- The closing comparison price is the last official NASDAQ sale price recorded for SPCX at or before 4:17 PM EDT on July 21, 2026; pre-market, after-hours, or off-exchange prices are excluded.
- Percentage increase is calculated as: ((comparison price − reference price) / reference price) × 100.
